source.notes: Production builds served statically; headless Chrome 155 on hardware WebGL2 (ANGLE, NVIDIA RTX A6000), 1400 px view, display 500 px tall, a 120-frame pan of 3 px a frame out and back, three interleaved reps after an untraced warm-up pan; each cell is the median over reps of the per-frame median of top-level main-thread RunTask ms. Load average 2.6 to 3.3. Frame time was 16.7 ms in every arm, so the cost is headroom inside the frame. The 6 mutations per frame in every OFF arm are the rest of the app. Illumina lays out 388 connectors, of which the 211 in the visible band draw. A sitting earlier the same day with the same harness read +2.32 / +0.15 and +1.29 / +0.24 ms, so the after cost is noise around zero and the HiFi before cost moves by about 0.4 ms between sittings.
